## Vamore (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
LE Medium aberration (zoanoid)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** blindsense 40 ft., darkvision 60 ft., Perception +13  


**Defense**


**AC** 19, touch 14, flat-footed15 (+4 Dex, +5 natural)  
**hp** 99 (9d8+27)  
**Fort** +8, **Ref** +7, **Will** +4  
**Immune** fire  
**Defensive Abilities** zoanoid saves  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +10 (1d6+3), 2 claws +9 (1d4+3)  
**Ranged** 2 fire beams +10 touch (3d6 fire plus burn)  
**Special Attacks** blazing rend, burn (DC 16, 1d6)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 16, **Dex** 19, **Con** 14, **Int** 11, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 23  
**Feats** Blind-fight, [Point-Blank Shot](../../rules/feats/point-blank-shot.md), Target of Opportunity, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Point-Blank Shot and Precise Shot are one feat, Point-Blank Shot; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +16, Climb +15, Perception +13, Stealth +16  
**Languages** Common, Zern  
**SQ** alter ego (Small or Medium humanoid, alter self)  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any land or underground  
**Organization** solitary, pair, squad (3-6) or battalion (7-24)  
**Treasure** standard  


**Special Abilities**


**Alter Ego (Su)** A vamore can assume the form of a specific Small or Medium humanoid. This functions as the change shape special quality, except that the vamore cannot choose the form it assumes.  

**Blazing Rend (Ex)** A creature struck by two of a vamore’s fire beams in a single round suffers a -2 penalty on its save against the vamore’s burn attack. If it fails its save, it takes 2d6 points of fire damage from the burn.  

**Blindsense (Ex)** A vamore’s blindsense is hearing based. It cannot use its blindsense if it is deafened or in the area of a silence spell or similar effect.  

**Fire Beams (Ex)** As a standard action, a vamore can fire two beams of fire from its shoulder pods. Treat these as ranged touch attacks with a range of 120 feet and no range increment. A creature struck takes 3d6 points of fire damage and is exposed to the vamore’s burn attack.  

**Zoanoid Saves (Ex)** A zoanid treats Fortitude as its good save and Will as a poor save.
